title: Handover
brief:
Only the **left arm** reaches the infeed, and only the **right arm** reaches the outfeed. Pass the green bar between them in mid-air.

Left arm: pick the bar and hold it at `give`. Right arm: close its gripper on the other end at `take`. Then the left arm lets go, and the right arm puts the bar on the outfeed.

A bar held by two grippers can’t be moved by one arm alone, so the arms have to take turns. Use **Wait for each other** at each hand-off.

predicates.label: Bar handed from the left to the right arm

hints: Three hand-offs need three “Wait for each other”: the bar is at `give`; the right arm has closed on it; the left arm has let go.
If the right arm moves while both grippers still hold the bar, you get SHARED_GRASP. Let the left arm open first.
